recent.label: Recent files

info.compatNone: No compatibility check was run for this document.

compat.unknownFinding: Content that may not be preserved ({{key}})
compat.unknownLoss: Some content may be lost in this format ({{key}})

saveAs.lossIntro: When saving in this format, the following may be lost or changed:
saveAs.hint: Next you choose the file name and location. Your original file stays unchanged unless you pick the same name.

exportPdf.intro: Creates a PDF copy of the document; the document itself does not change.
exportPdf.openAfterHint: The PDF opens in a new tab in Simpaper's PDF module.
exportPdf.taggedHint: Adds the document structure for screen readers.
exportPdf.bookmarksHint: Shows as a table of contents in PDF viewers.
exportPdf.pdfAHint: Embeds fonts for long-term storage; turns off some features.
exportPdf.hybridHint: Puts an open-format copy of the document inside the PDF; the file gets larger.

print.hintOffice: Choose the printer, page range and number of copies in the print dialog of the document engine.
print.hintPdf: Choose the printer and pages in the next dialog.

recover.intro: Unsaved work that was stored automatically before an unexpected shutdown.
recover.reasonShutdown: The app did not close properly

options.autosaveHint: 0 = off. Recovery copies never overwrite your original file.
options.verifyAfterSaveHint: The written file is reopened and checked before it replaces the original. Slower but safer.
options.recentLimit: Number of files in the recent list
options.csvBom: Write a UTF-8 BOM (other apps then detect Turkish characters correctly)
options.csvHint: Automatic: semicolon with a Turkish locale, comma with English.
options.documentKeyTips: KeyTips while working in a document (Alt or F10) — experimental
options.documentKeyTipsHint: Pressing Alt or F10 while the document window is active shows the ribbon KeyTips. This uses a keyboard hook while Simpaper is in the foreground; keys are never stored or sent anywhere.
options.qatHint: Choose and order the commands shown in the title bar.
options.fileTypesHint: Setup registered these file types with Windows, with Simpaper's icons. In Windows, only you decide which app opens a type: switch the types that open with another app to Simpaper in Windows Settings.
options.fileTypesTextHint: Setup leaves the default apps of plain text, CSV and TSV files as they are: Simpaper is only offered for them, under “Open with” and on its Default apps page.
options.fileTypesNotRegistered: This copy of Simpaper has not registered any file types with Windows (a development run or the ZIP archive). Simpaper installed with its setup program registers documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDF files with its own icons.
options.fileTypesOtherCopy: The registered file types start another Simpaper installation on this computer, not this copy.
options.fileTypesOpenFailed: Windows Settings could not be opened.

about.description: Simpaper is an open-source office suite for documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDF files. It works offline with your local files.
about.license: Simpaper is free software licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0).
about.engineLicense: The document engine is distributed unmodified; its own license texts and notices ship with the installation.
about.linkEngineSource: Source code of the document engine
about.privacy: Simpaper collects no telemetry or usage data and never sends your files anywhere.
about.trademarks: Product and format names mentioned may be trademarks of their owners; they are used only to describe compatibility.

saveRisk.body: If "{{fileName}}" is saved as {{format}}, the following may be lost or changed:
saveRisk.explain: The safe option is to save a copy and leave the original untouched. The open document format (ODF) keeps all content.

unsaved.title: Save your changes?
unsaved.body: Do you want to save the changes to "{{fileName}}"?

newer.title: The file was changed elsewhere
newer.body: "{{fileName}}" was changed by another program after you opened it. Overwriting it loses those changes.

stuck.title: The document can't be saved
stuck.body: The engine of "{{fileName}}" is not responding or has stopped, so the document can't be saved now.
stuck.snapshot: If you close it, changes made after the automatic save at {{time}} are lost. That save stays in File → Recover.
stuck.noSnapshot: If you close it, unsaved changes are lost; there is no automatic save of this document.
